comment: The boxes and the links that the command line and the editor draw for the views of layer `technology` and viewpoint `map` of the example src/doc/examples/domain_technology_map (wave 015, run 0099, issue #92). One file, read by TechnologyMapTest.java (the viewpoint of the command line) and technology-map-shared.test.js (the page of a view in the editor, over the embedded kernel): either side drifting fails a test. A box is the reference of its element, a link is `from -> to` between two boxes. Both lists are sorted.
